t: The question that stopped him for a long time
a: إِنَّ أَكْثَرَ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مَا يُخْرِجُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِ الأَرْضِ
p: Inna akthara mā akhāfu ʿalaykum mā yukhriju-Llāhu lakum min barakāti-l-arḍ
m: What I fear most for you is what Allah will bring out for you of the blessings of the earth.
